_about: tent: guests sleep in their tents from in_hour (their requests wait till morning); a player within reach_m of the camp's own tent crawls in to sleep; a tent with someone inside opens up (roof lifted away) for a player within peek_m; bags (a guest tent) and home_bags (the camp's tent, one per player) are sleeping bags [x, feet z, cover model]: a sleeper lies face up with its feet at that spot, lie_y_m up, tipped lie_deg, at lie_scale, tucked under the cover model to the chin; each guest tent has a name bubble bubble_y_m up. Stage B's guests (scripts/camp/camp_guests.gd): small requests, how a stay is scored, and advance bookings. Every guest brings one request, picked in turn from request_order among those open today (from_day, a day number). A request with give is met by handing the guest an item of that kind from your pockets (data/fishing.json items) within talk_reach_m of where they stand; a request with near is met when one of those models stands within radius_m of their pitch. A met request pays its tip at once, and more.wait_min game minutes later the guest asks for something else, up to more.per_day requests a day (rows of [from day number, requests]: guests ask more as the season goes on). When a stay ends, it is scored once: each satisfaction source met is one point (near: one of the models within radius_m of the pitch, from the camp's objects or the clearing's scenery; request: the guest's request was met), the guest tips tip_per_point coins a point, and moods names the mood from that many points up. The guest's line names the first source met as what they loved and the first missed as what they wished for. bookings are offered on offer_day (a day number, day 1 is the first morning) for arrive_day; accepted, they arrive from data/day.json stays.arrive_hour on that day or the first day after it with essential.pitches free pitches, and wait patiently until then. Each optional build standing in the camp when they arrive adds its bonus to their first night. Names live in data/text.json booking.<id>. activities (scripts/camp/guest_plans.gd): a guest with no open request, awake, spends each slot_min game minutes on one of kinds, picked steadily from the day and the slot so both PCs agree: fishing, photographing or kite flying at the first free spot of that kind (at, facing look, holding prop from data/items.json tools.held; a spot within clear_m of a camp object is skipped), sitting on a seat (sit.seats: a seat model -> spots [x, z] in its own space at seat height y; the fire ring adds its log seats facing fire_at), or resting by their tent. With two free guests, in a share chance of slots two of them throw a frisbee model across the first clear lawn (spots: middle and yaw, ends half_m either side), flight_s through an arc_m arc from hand_y_m (reach_m out in front), held hold_s by the catcher, spinning spin_hz.
